name: ae-tax-residency
description: UAE tax residency for individuals in 2026 under Cabinet Decision No. 85 of 2022 (in force since 1 March 2023). Covers the three tests (centre of life, 183 days, 90 days with a residence permit or nationality plus a permanent home or work in the UAE), how days are counted, the tax residency certificate (domestic or treaty), its evidence and FTA fees, what residency means (no personal income tax, Corporate Tax only on business turnover above AED 1,000,000) and why a UAE visa does not end residency
author: openaccountants
